page.layout: One page of text in a single column; page number and running head at the top; catchword "TRA-" at the foot right; numbered verse-marker sidenotes ("24", "25") are inline section numbers in the text; no marginal notes outside the column except scanner edge.

main_text.p: cuius tamen vinculis nihil alibi scriptum legi-mus, vt quando in vincula inciderit difficile admodum sit diuinare) & Epistolæ huius auctorem liberum fuisse ac suæ potestatis cum hæc scriberet.

24 Salutate omnes) Paucis complectitur salutationes, primùm (vt sic dicam) rogatas, quibus salutari petit, tum omnes ductores ipsorum & Pastores, tum generatim omnes sanctos: deinde (vt sic dicam) missas ab Italicis fratribus.

25 Gratia sit) Hebraeis valedicens comprecatur ijs gratiam, quo nomine intelligo, primum gratuitum Dei fauorem, deinde spirituales in Christo benedictiones, quæ ex gratuito Dei fauore omnes emanant; cuiusmodi sunt remissio peccatorum, iustificatio, sanctificatio, vita denique æterna. Hanc gratiam exoptat omnibus, quia vt sua natura ad omnes pertinet (vt videre est Rom. 5. 15. & deinceps) ita à Pastore non est contrahenda ad certos duntaxat aliquot, sed omnibus & singulis quantum in ipso est, communicanda & exoptanda à Deo, cui in Christo sit omnis gloria. Amen.

page.notes: Catchword "TRA-" at foot right. Printed text is partly faded at the right edge; some line ends and the sidenote-like section numbers were read as inline. Several words in the indented verse-reference lines are uncertain, notably "Hebraeis" and "compre-catur".
